name: fastbee-arduino
description: FastBee IoT Platform for ESP32 - Automated testing and validation

scripts.test:host: npm run test:static && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:regression: npm run test:host && npm run test:native
scripts.test:web-assets: node scripts/build-web-assets.js && node scripts/web-smoke-test.js && node scripts/test-gzip-www-contract.js --publish-only && node scripts/gzip-www.js --no-upload --no-monitor --stage-dir=.pio/test-fs-stage && node scripts/web-smoke-test.js && node scripts/test-gzip-www-contract.js --stage-dir=.pio/test-fs-stage
scripts.test:static: node scripts/check-utf8-text.js README.md README.en.md docs scripts test web-src include src data/config/peripherals.json data/config/periph_exec.json data/config/users.json && node scripts/validate-test-coverage.js && node scripts/validate-device-api-matrix.js && node scripts/validate-device-config-examples.js && node scripts/validate-mqtt-ntp-lifecycle.js && node scripts/validate-build-matrix.js && node scripts/validate-doc-links.js && node scripts/validate-stability-thresholds.js && node scripts/validate-config-defaults.js && node scripts/validate-i18n.js && node scripts/validate-file-sizes.js && node scripts/validate-rule-script-profile.js && node scripts/validate-libdeps-patches.js && node scripts/validate-feature-budgets.js && node scripts/validate-project-hygiene.js && node scripts/test-fim-manifest-validator.js && node scripts/validate-generic-architecture.js && node scripts/validate-network-ui.js && npm run test:web-assets && npm run test:meta && git diff --check
scripts.test:meta: node scripts/test-config-sanitizer.js && node scripts/test-project-hygiene-credentials.js && node scripts/test-deploy-pio-observability.js && node scripts/test-test-all-contract.js && node scripts/test-test-coverage-validator.js && node scripts/test-build-artifacts-validator.js && node scripts/test-device-config-examples-validator.js && node scripts/test-native-runner.js && node scripts/test-utf8-checker.js && node scripts/test-device-discovery.js
scripts.test:contracts: npm run test:partition && npm run test:memory && npm run test:device-config
scripts.precommit: npm run test:static && npm run test:contracts && echo 'Pre-commit validation passed!'
